theme_strategy: Supports both Light and Dark modes. Dark mode emphasizes the 'Electric/Neon' vibe, Light mode focuses on 'Crisp High-Contrast' with vivid accents.

typography.anti_pattern_reminder: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Keep headings energetic.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Vibrant Play

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl combined with surface_glass color for Sticky Headers, Top Nav, and Quick Access Floating Bar. Add 1px inner border for clarity.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Do not use soft neumorphism. Use 'Tactile Variant': flat surfaces with 1px crisp borders, and on hover, add a subtle glow shadow.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton via Grid Borders where applicable. No fully rounded pills except for small badges. Max border-radius for cards is 12px (rounded-xl).
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: In the Hero section, overlay the electric grid background image with bg-black/60 (dark mode) or bg-white/70 (light mode) so text remains AA accessible. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.

grids_and_layouts.general: Left-aligned, asymmetric layout. Avoid Bootstrap-style even columns everywhere.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. 280px width on desktop.
grids_and_layouts.main_content: Left-aligned within the main container. Generous padding (p-6 to p-10).
grids_and_layouts.kpi_grid: Bento-style. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. One KPI spans 2 columns, the rest span 1.
grids_and_layouts.resource_grid: Dense Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Stretch cards to full height (h-full).

components.category_filters: Pill-shaped tabs (rounded-full). Active state uses primary_accent background with white text. Inactive uses transparent background with subtle border.
components.resource_cards: Use standard div wrappers, NOT generic shadcn Card, to allow custom hover glows. Structure: Category badge top right, lucide-react icon top left, Bold title, two-line truncated description, external link arrow button at bottom.
components.charts: Recharts. Donut chart for category distribution. Bar chart for resource types. Ensure colors map to the brand accents (Blue, Red, Yellow).
components.quick_access: Horizontal scrollable flex container or a specialized asymmetric top row. Add 'lucide-react' icons like Zap for styra, FileSpreadsheet for Salary.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-1), border color changes to primary_accent, and subtle colored drop-shadow appears.
motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in + slide-up for KPI cards and Resource cards (staggerChildren: 0.05).
motion.buttons: Active scale down (scale-95). Glow effect on hover for primary CTA.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA minimum. Never put light gray text on white background.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements, category filters, resource cards, and search inputs.

media_and_icons.icons: lucide-react. Use Zap for company logo/branding. FileText, Activity, Users, DollarSign, Database, Shield, Zap.

images.description: Electric power grid silhouette at sunset
images.placement: Hero header background with heavy blur and opacity (10-15%)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto fonts. Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body.
CREATE a toggle for Dark/Light mode, do not force only one.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and headers. Ensure NO fully transparent backgrounds on elements with content under them.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, staggered reveals via framer-motion.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Do NOT center align the app container. Left-align text for better reading flow.
Never use generic AI emojis. Use ONLY lucide-react icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use this JSON to construct a highly functional, visually energetic dashboard in JS (not TS). Implement the sidebar navigation, a top hero header (using the grid image with an overlay), KPI stat cards using framer-motion staggers, and a dense, asymmetric grid of 19 resource links categorized properly. Use Recharts for the BI charts. Ensure Shadcn components are adapted to fit the 'Performance Pro' aesthetic (sharp, tactile, non-bland). Follow the left-aligned layout convention and strictly apply the chosen typography and color archetypes.
